# ── WORKSPACE_DATA_DIR target ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Pool-probes (e.g. firestaff_dm1_v1_champion_mirror_visibility_runtime_probe)
# take the data directory as a positional CLI argument. Their add_test()
# commands use the generator expression
#   $<IF:$<TARGET_EXISTS:WORKSPACE_DATA_DIR>,
#         $<TARGET_PROPERTY:WORKSPACE_DATA_DIR,VALUE>,
#         ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/builds/nv1-build>
# so the target just needs to exist with a VALUE property set to a
# valid data directory. Default to the Firestaff canonical user data
# root; callers may override with -DFIRESTAFF_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIR=... on
# the cmake command line.
if(NOT DEFINED FIRESTAFF_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIR)
    set(FIRESTAFF_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIR "$ENV{HOME}/.firestaff/data")
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED FIRESTAFF_DM1_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIR)
    set(FIRESTAFF_DM1_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIR "$ENV{HOME}/.firestaff/data/dm1")
endif()
if(NOT TARGET WORKSPACE_DATA_DIR)
    add_library(WORKSPACE_DATA_DIR INTERFACE IMPORTED GLOBAL)
endif()
set_target_properties(WORKSPACE_DATA_DIR PROPERTIES
    "VALUE" "${FIRESTAFF_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIR}"
)

include_directories(include src)


set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# ── Compiler warnings ────────────────────────────────────────────────
if(MSVC)
    add_compile_options(/W4)
else()
    # M11/M12 targets get strict warnings; M10 gets relaxed treatment.
    # We set per-target below.
endif()

# ── SDL discovery (prefer SDL3, fall back to SDL2) ──────────────────
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
find_package(SDL3 QUIET CONFIG)
if(SDL3_FOUND)
    message(STATUS "Found SDL3")
else()
    pkg_check_modules(SDL3 QUIET IMPORTED_TARGET sdl3)
endif()
if(NOT SDL3_FOUND AND NOT TARGET PkgConfig::SDL3)
    pkg_check_modules(SDL2 QUIET IMPORTED_TARGET sdl2)
    if(SDL2_FOUND OR TARGET PkgConfig::SDL2)
        message(STATUS "SDL3 not found, using SDL2")
        if(NOT TARGET SDL3::SDL3)
            add_library(SDL3::SDL3 ALIAS PkgConfig::SDL2)
        endif()
    else()
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Neither SDL3 nor SDL2 found")
    endif()
else()
    if(NOT TARGET SDL3::SDL3 AND TARGET PkgConfig::SDL3)
        add_library(SDL3::SDL3 ALIAS PkgConfig::SDL3)
    endif()
endif()

# ── Python discovery for source-shape/evidence gates ───────────────
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter QUIET)

# -- zlib discovery (optional, used by asset-scanner ZIP/gzip paths) --
#
# Default to Firestaff's bundled miniz provider so release binaries do not
# gain a runtime dependency on a Homebrew/pkg-config zlib dylib.  System zlib
# remains available for explicit platform builds and as a fallback if a packager
# disables the bundled provider.
option(FIRESTAFF_WITH_ZLIB "Enable zlib-backed ZIP/gzip inflate support" ON)
option(FIRESTAFF_WITH_BUNDLED_ZLIB "Use bundled miniz for zlib-compatible inflate support" ON)
set(FIRESTAFF_ZLIB_TARGET "")
set(FIRESTAFF_ZLIB_PROVIDER "")
if(FIRESTAFF_WITH_ZLIB)
    if(FIRESTAFF_WITH_BUNDLED_ZLIB)
        add_library(firestaff_zlib STATIC
            third_party/miniz/miniz.c
            third_party/miniz/miniz_tdef.c
            third_party/miniz/miniz_tinfl.c
        )
        target_include_directories(firestaff_zlib PUBLIC
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/miniz
        )
        if(NOT MSVC)
            target_compile_options(firestaff_zlib PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -O2)
        endif()
        set(FIRESTAFF_ZLIB_TARGET firestaff_zlib)
        set(FIRESTAFF_ZLIB_PROVIDER "bundled miniz")
    else()
        find_package(ZLIB QUIET)
        if(TARGET ZLIB::ZLIB)
            set(FIRESTAFF_ZLIB_TARGET ZLIB::ZLIB)
            set(FIRESTAFF_ZLIB_PROVIDER "ZLIB::ZLIB")
        else()
            pkg_check_modules(FIRESTAFF_PKG_ZLIB QUIET IMPORTED_TARGET zlib)
            if(TARGET PkgConfig::FIRESTAFF_PKG_ZLIB)
                set(FIRESTAFF_ZLIB_TARGET PkgConfig::FIRESTAFF_PKG_ZLIB)
                set(FIRESTAFF_ZLIB_PROVIDER "PkgConfig::FIRESTAFF_PKG_ZLIB")
            endif()
        endif()
    endif()
endif()
if(FIRESTAFF_ZLIB_TARGET)
    set(FIRESTAFF_HAS_ZLIB 1 CACHE BOOL "Whether Firestaff is built with zlib for ZIP/gzip inflate" FORCE)
    message(STATUS "Found zlib via ${FIRESTAFF_ZLIB_PROVIDER} - ZIP/gzip inflate paths enabled")
else()
    set(FIRESTAFF_HAS_ZLIB 0 CACHE BOOL "Whether Firestaff is built with zlib for ZIP/gzip inflate" FORCE)
    message(STATUS "zlib not found - ZIP/gzip inflate paths fall back to stored/header-only handling")
endif()

function(firestaff_link_zlib target visibility)
    if(FIRESTAFF_HAS_ZLIB)
        target_compile_definitions(${target} ${visibility} FIRESTAFF_HAS_ZLIB=1)
        target_link_libraries(${target} ${visibility} ${FIRESTAFF_ZLIB_TARGET})
    endif()
endfunction()

# ── DM2 V2 static library ──────────────────────────────────────────

    add_library(firestaff_dm2_v2 STATIC ${DM2_V2_SOURCES})
    target_include_directories(firestaff_dm2_v2 PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
    # firestaff_v2 provides dm1_v2_movement_command_route_for_presentation
    # which dm2_v2_touch_controller_affordance.c references for the
    # V2 affordance → DM1 movement command → V1 command queue path.
    # Without this link, Linux/Windows release builds fail with
    # undefined reference errors. Source: dm1v2/dm1_v2_movement_command_adapter_pc34.c.
    target_link_libraries(firestaff_dm2_v2 PUBLIC firestaff_m10 firestaff_v2 m)
    # dm2_v2_hud_widget_bitmap_blit.c decodes synthetic 1x1 PNG IDAT
    # chunks via the bundled miniz. Linking PUBLIC so the standalone
    # bitmap-blit probe (and any future real-art blit path) inherit
    # FIRESTAFF_HAS_ZLIB without re-declaring the linkage contract.
    # Source: src/dm2/dm2_v2_hud_widget_bitmap_blit.c
    firestaff_link_zlib(firestaff_dm2_v2 PUBLIC)
    if(NOT MSVC)
        target_compile_options(firestaff_dm2_v2 PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -O2)
    endif()

add_library(firestaff_m11 STATIC ${M11_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(firestaff_m11 PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(firestaff_m11 PUBLIC firestaff_nexus firestaff_v2 firestaff_m10 firestaff_theron SDL3::SDL3 m)
# main_loop_m11.c + m11_game_view.c reference M12_* startup-menu and
# config helpers that live in firestaff_m12.a. Expose that link
# requirement through firestaff_m11's PUBLIC interface so every
# consumer (the firestaff executable and every probe that links
# firestaff_m11) gets firestaff_m12 in its final link line. The
# reverse circular link from m12 back to m11 is harmless because
# CMake deduplicates static-lib pulls when both are listed.
target_link_libraries(firestaff_m11 PUBLIC firestaff_m12)
if(DM2_SOURCES)
    # 2026-06-17: DM2 V1 hand-off added in M11_GameView_Start (see
    # M11_GameView_StartDm2 in m11_game_view.c). Links the DM2 V1 boot
    # profile + runtime so --game dm2 reaches dm2_v1_boot_enter_game.
    target_link_libraries(firestaff_m11 PUBLIC firestaff_dm2)
endif()
if(CSB_V2_SOURCES)
    target_link_libraries(firestaff_m11 PUBLIC firestaff_csb_v2)
endif()
if(DM2_V2_SOURCES)
    target_link_libraries(firestaff_m11 PUBLIC firestaff_dm2_v2)
endif()
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(firestaff_m11 PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -O2)
    # src/engine/m11_game_view.c is a large legacy file — relax truncation/unused warnings.
    # -Wno-maybe-uninitialized is a GCC-only flag; skip on Clang/MSVC to avoid
    # -Wunknown-warning-option noise.
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
        set_source_files_properties(src/engine/m11_game_view.c PROPERTIES
            COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wno-format-truncation;-Wno-unused-function;-Wno-maybe-uninitialized"
        )
    else()
        set_source_files_properties(src/engine/m11_game_view.c PROPERTIES
            COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wno-format-truncation;-Wno-unused-function"
        )
    endif()
    # src/dm1/dm1_v1_viewport_3d_pc34_compat.c intentionally switches on
    # CSB-specific view squares (D3L2/D3R2/D2L2/D2R2 = -101..-104) that
    # are macros, not enum members of DM1_ViewSquareIndex. Clang and GCC
    # raise -Wswitch "case value not in enumerated type" for those
    # branches, which would shift line numbers and break the dozens of
    # parity-evidence source-lock verifiers that pin specific lines in
    # this file. Silence -Wswitch per-source instead of adding a pragma
    # that would offset the line counter.
    set_source_files_properties(src/dm1/dm1_v1_viewport_3d_pc34_compat.c PROPERTIES
        COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wno-switch"
    )
endif()

            -Wno-format-truncation -Wno-array-bounds -Wno-unused-variable)
    endif()

# ── Main executable ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
add_executable(firestaff src/shared/firestaff_main_m11.c)
# M11 objects referenced by the executable call back into M12 menu/asset helpers;
# repeat M12 after M11 so static linkers resolve both directions.
# firestaff_v2 and firestaff_m10 are already pulled in transitively:
#   firestaff_m12 PUBLIC firestaff_m11, firestaff_v2
#   firestaff_m11 PUBLIC firestaff_v2, firestaff_m10
# firestaff_m11 is also pulled in transitively by firestaff_m12's PUBLIC
# link, so listing it explicitly here only triggers ld's "ignoring duplicate
# libraries" warning without changing the resolved symbol set. The static
# linker resolves all M11 symbols referenced by the executable's object file
# from the single transitively-pulled libfirestaff_m11.a that m12 brings
# along. firestaff_m12 is intentionally listed twice (after m11's transitive
# pull) so the linker resolves M12 symbols referenced from M11-transitively
# pulled objects in both directions.
target_link_libraries(firestaff PRIVATE firestaff_m12 firestaff_m12 SDL3::SDL3)
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(firestaff PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -O2)
endif()

# ── Probe executables ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# M11 Phase A probe (only needs render_sdl + vga_palette, linked via m10)
add_executable(firestaff_m11_phase_a_probe probes/m11/firestaff_m11_phase_a_probe.c)
# firestaff_m11 includes main_loop_m11.c which references M12_* symbols;
# those resolve through firestaff_m12 on Linux/Windows strict linkers
# (macOS / BSD ld is more permissive and resolves them anyway).
target_link_libraries(firestaff_m11_phase_a_probe PRIVATE firestaff_m11 firestaff_m12 firestaff_v2 firestaff_m10 SDL3::SDL3)
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(firestaff_m11_phase_a_probe PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -O2)
endif()

# 2026-06-28 gapbug: Theron V1 startup-adjacent input/movement wall-block gate.
# Headless: no game assets, no Track 02 data, no SDL rendering required.
# Exercises the same M11 game-view input dispatcher
# (M11_GameView_HandleInput) the live M11_GameView_StartTheron() handoff
# would route through once Track 02 data is verified, against the

# firestaff_theron_v1_mechanics_hardening_probe (which tests

# firestaff_theron_v1_cross_route_mechanics_probe (which tests the

# DM2 V2.2 per-cell modern-art swap WIRE-UP probe. Headless synthetic probe
# that stages a minimal v22_inplace_cache.bin, installs the V22 modern pack
# presentation flag, wires a synthetic DM2 V1 boot profile to defeat the
# runtime headless early exit, populates the per-cell swap cache (indoor
# T560 + outdoor T600), and verifies that dm2_v2_runtime_render_frame()
# (the same M11 entry point firestaff_game_loop.c drives per V1 tick)
# now reaches the swap render pass.
#
# Failure mode this probe catches: future refactors that remove or
# guard-out the dm2_v22_viewport_swap_render() call inside
# dm2_v2_runtime_render_frame(). The runtime-mediated overwrite count
# would drop to 0 and the per-viewport counters invariant would flip.
#
# Source-lock: SKULL.ASM T520/T560/T600 + ReDMCSB DUNVIEW.C:2962-3070 +
# include/dm2_v22_viewport_swap_pc34.h + src/dm2/dm2_v2_runtime.c.

    src/dm2/dm2_v22_shape_cache_pc34.c
    src/dm2/dm2_v22_modern_assets_pc34.c
    src/dm2/dm2_v2_runtime.c
    src/dm2/dm2_v2_viewport_renderer.c
    src/dm2/dm2_v2_smooth_movement.c
    src/dm2/dm2_v1_runtime.c
    src/dm1v2/dm1_v2_anim_timing_pc34.c
    src/shared/fs_portable_compat.c)

# DM1 V2 actual-render screenshot / pixel-fixture probe. Headless: no game
# data, host-agnostic (uses SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy). Drives the real V2
# render pipeline for V1 / V2.0 / V2.1 / V2.2, writes a 24-bit BMP
# fixture per mode under a probe-controlled temp dir, and asserts the

# DM1 V2 source-owned deterministic screenshot script. Headless:
# skip-safe when no DM1 PC 3.4 DUNGEON.DAT is present (exits 0 with
# SKIP message). When DUNGEON.DAT is present it drives the real M11
# present pipeline (V1 / V2.0 filtered / V2.1 EPX / V2.2 in-place
# overlay) for the four N/E/S/W directions of the canonical PC 3.4
# entry composition built from the real DUNGEON.DAT bytes. Writes a
# 24-bit BMP per (direction, mode) and a single JSON receipts file
# listing per-row FNV-1a 32-bit hashes for the on-disk BMPs. The
# receipts file is the input to
# tools/verify_dm1_v2_source_owned_screenshot_receipts.py which is
# registered as a second CTest gate below.
# Source-lock: ReDMCSB DUNVIEW.C:2999-3000 + 8318-8542, DUNGEON.C:2199-2250,
# VIDEODRV.C G9010_auc_VgaPaletteAll_Compat, GAMELOOP.C:90 + F0128.
add_executable(firestaff_dm1_v2_source_owned_screenshot_probe
    probes/firestaff_dm1_v2_source_owned_screenshot_probe.c)
target_include_directories(firestaff_dm1_v2_source_owned_screenshot_probe PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
target_link_libraries(firestaff_dm1_v2_source_owned_screenshot_probe
    PRIVATE firestaff_m11 firestaff_m10 SDL3::SDL3)
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(firestaff_dm1_v2_source_owned_screenshot_probe PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -O2)
endif()
if(BUILD_TESTING)
    add_test(
        NAME dm1_v2_source_owned_screenshot_probe
        COMMAND firestaff_dm1_v2_source_owned_screenshot_probe
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
    )
    set_tests_properties(dm1_v2_source_owned_screenshot_probe PROPERTIES
        LABELS "tier2;dm1;v2;screenshot;source-owned;deterministic"
    )
endif()

# DM1 V2 source-owned screenshot receipt verifier. Reads the JSON
# manifest emitted by firestaff_dm1_v2_source_owned_screenshot_probe,
# re-derives FNV-1a 32-bit hashes of every on-disk BMP, and asserts
# BM magic + width/height + size + per-row hash invariants. Skip-safe
# when no receipts file is present (exits 0). No DOSBox parity claim;
# this proves the source-owned route is deterministic end-to-end on
# the Firestaff side only.

    NAME dm1_v2_source_owned_screenshot_receipts

#   - ReDMCSB DUNGEON.C F0151 lines 1423-1475 (column-major square access).
#   - ReDMCSB GAMELOOP.C F0002 lines 69-124 (V1 tick at game_time boundary).

#     squares), 2668-2677 (cell orders), 4045-4046 (C705/C706),

# advance per scale step (8, 16, 24), the 192 px source dialog choice zones (C462/C463),
# 4-choice split zones (C466/C467) at 86 px each, the V1 message area zone (C015)
# geometry, the production override that keeps the V1 message log at scale 1
# even when state->fontScale is bumped to 2 or 3, and the session-timer
# reminder banner's top-strip fit / V1 viewport ownership at fontScale 1..3.
# Source: ReDMCSB layout-696, M2092_MessageAreaWidth=320, M532_MESSAGE_AREA_ROW_COUNT=4,
#         G2088_C7_TextLineHeight=7, G2089_C8_InscriptionCharacterWidth=8,
#         G2082_C5_CharacterPadding=5 (X_OFFSET = 8 - 5 = 3),
#         G2087_C6_InscriptionCharacterWidth=6, G2083_C3=6 visible rows.

# DM1 V1 Hall of Champions portrait ordinal 1 (HALK) front_east_entry
# portrait_rect_position runtime probe.  Source-locked to:
#   DUNGEON.C:2573 visibleWallCell = (partyDirection + 2) & 3 selects
#     the source-visible wall bit on the front cell.
#   DUNGEON.C:2608-2612 stores C127 sensorData in G0289.
#   DUNVIEW.C:3913-3928 D1C champion portrait blit (C026) at viewport
#     (96, 35) sized 32x29, source cell (ord&7)*32, (ord>>3)*29.
#   DUNVIEW.C:525 G0109_auc_Graphic558_Box_ChampionPortraitOnWall =
#     { 96, 127, 35, 63 }.
#   DUNVIEW.C:4547-4581 G0289 ordinal decode.
#   DUNVIEW.C:8318-8542 F0128 viewport redraw order (far-to-near).
#   MOVESENS.C:1501-1503 passes C127 sensorData to F0280 candidate.
# The probe drives the (2, 1) DIR_EAST front_east_entry pose,
# mutates the (3, 1) west-wall C127 sensorData from 8 (VIBIA,
# shipped) to 1 (HALK), and asserts the D1C portrait rect at
# viewport (96, 35, 32, 29) renders the C026 ordinal 1 strip cell
# at >= 95% per-pixel agreement.  After restore, the D1C rect no
# longer matches ordinal 1 and the front ordinal returns to 8.
# Side walls (NORTH, SOUTH, WEST) at (2, 1) do not show ordinal 1
# pixels (no float), and the (2, 1) SOUTH pose correctly reports
# ordinal 4 (LEIF) -- proving the (3, 1) sensor mutation does not
# leak through the south front cell.  Sibling to the ordinal-XX
# front_north_entry / south_return probes (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7,
# 8, 9, 10, 14, 21) but for the east-facing entry pose.  This is
# a Firestaff-runtime slice proof, not DOS pixel parity.
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/probes/m11/firestaff_dm1_v1_hoc_champion_portrait_01_front_east_entry_portrait_rect_position_runtime_probe.c")
    add_executable(firestaff_dm1_v1_hoc_champion_portrait_01_front_east_entry_portrait_rect_position_runtime_probe
        probes/m11/firestaff_dm1_v1_hoc_champion_portrait_01_front_east_entry_portrait_rect_position_runtime_probe.c
    )
    target_link_libraries(firestaff_dm1_v1_hoc_champion_portrait_01_front_east_entry_portrait_rect_position_runtime_probe PRIVATE firestaff_m12 firestaff_m11 firestaff_v2 firestaff_m10)
    if(NOT MSVC)
        target_compile_options(firestaff_dm1_v1_hoc_champion_portrait_01_front_east_entry_portrait_rect_position_runtime_probe PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -O2)
    endif()
    add_test(
        NAME firestaff_dm1_v1_hoc_champion_portrait_01_front_east_entry_portrait_rect_position_runtime_probe
        COMMAND firestaff_dm1_v1_hoc_champion_portrait_01_front_east_entry_portrait_rect_position_runtime_probe
            "${FIRESTAFF_DM1_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIR}"
    )
endif()

        "probes/m11/firestaff_dm1_v1_hoc_champion_portrait_09_after_party_shuffle_portrait_rect_position_runtime_probe.c"
        "probes/m11/firestaff_dm1_v1_hoc_champion_portrait_02_after_party_shuffle_portrait_rect_position_runtime_probe.c"
        "probes/m11/firestaff_dm1_v1_hoc_champion_portrait_03_double_click_stability_portrait_rect_position_075_gate_probe.c"
        "probes/m11/firestaff_dm1_v1_hoc_champion_portrait_03_save_load_reopen_portrait_rect_position_219_gate_probe.c"

# DM1 V1 Hall of Champions portrait ordinal 08 / sleep_repaint /
# portrait_rect_position runtime probe.  Source-locked to
# DUNGEON.C:2573 + 2608-2612 + MOVESENS.C:1501-1503 + REVIVE.C F0280
# + DUNVIEW.C:3913-3928 + 525 G0109 + 8318-8542 F0128 + 7727-7924
# F0124 + COORD.C:1693-1749 + DEFS.H:821-826/2186 +
# main_loop_m11.c:2620 + m11_game_view.c:7438 AdvanceIdleTick.
# Patches the (1,2) NORTH C127 sensor from 1 (HALK, shipped) to 8
# (IAIDO) to lock ordinal 8 on the (1,2) NORTH D1C route, then
# drives M11_GameView_AdvanceIdleTick for 200 + 400 = 600 idle
# ticks (the M11 main loop's "sleep" path: mouth animation +
# m11_apply_tick on the resting party) and re-renders the
# framebuffer.  Verifies the D1C portrait rectangle (96, 35, 32, 29)
# still carries ordinal 8 pixels at >= 90% match, the warm-count is
# stable vs the baseline (|delta| <= 10% of baseline), the front-
# mirror ordinal stays at 8 (idle ticks must not disable the C127
# sensor or invoke F0280/F0282), the party pose is unchanged, no
# floating on the left/right side walls, and ordinal 8 dominates the
# per-ordinal match (best == 8, second-best strictly less).  This
# is the ordinal-8 / sleep_repaint gate from the gate table; it is
# disjoint from the ordinal-8 / south_return probe (no idle ticks,
# south-facing pose), the ordinal-8 / cancel_reopen probe (no idle

# DM1 V1 Hall of Champions portrait-12 screenshot_receipt_rect runtime
# probe. Registered via the pool-promote foreach loop above (line ~2086).
# Source-locked contract for the on-disk BMP receipt of the LINFLAS pose
# at (2,10,N): renders the pose to the M11 320x200 indexed framebuffer,
# captures a 24-bit BMP via M11_Screenshot_Capture, re-reads it from
# disk, and decodes the source-locked D1C portrait rectangle
# (96,35,32,29) back into palette indices using G9010_auc_VgaPaletteAll_Compat
# to assert the LINFLAS portrait pixels made it onto disk correctly.
# Proves:
#   (A) receipt byte stability: BMP file on disk is well-formed (BM magic,
#       320x200, source-locked 192054 byte footprint, 14+40 header +
#       960*200 image payload with 320*3 = 960 row stride already
#       4-aligned).
#   (B) rect received ordinal 12: decoded D1C rect on disk matches C026
#       ordinal-12 opaque pixels above the 90% threshold, AND the
#       dominant ordinal in the decoded rect is 12 (rules out a
#       wrong-ordinal paint that happens to satisfy the threshold).
#   (C) no floating negative: the same screenshot receipt path run for
#       the no-portrait side pose (2,10,EAST) shows ordinal-12 leak pct
#       below 35% in the decoded D1C rect.
# Source evidence: DUNGEON.C:2558,2573,2608-2612; MOVESENS.C:1501-1503;
#                  REVIVE.C F0280,F0282; DUNVIEW.C:3913-3928,8318-8542,
#                  8522-8533; COORD.C:1693-1722; DEFS.H:2071-2079;
#                  GAMELOOP.C:90 + F0128; screenshot_m11.c (24-bit BMP
#                  writer); vga_palette_pc34_compat.h (G9010 palette).

if(BUILD_TESTING)
    function(firestaff_add_test_if_missing test_name)
        get_property(_firestaff_existing_tests DIRECTORY PROPERTY TESTS)
        list(FIND _firestaff_existing_tests "${test_name}" _firestaff_test_index)
        if(_firestaff_test_index EQUAL -1)
            add_test(
                NAME ${test_name}
                COMMAND ${ARGN}
            )
        endif()
    endfunction()

    # DM1 V1 steal-from-slot-indices: GROUP.C F0193 (StealFromChampion)
    # uses G0025_auc_Graphic562_StealFromSlotIndices[8] in post-1.3 Atari
    # versions (or G0394 in pre-1.3 Atari; G0025 is the init source per
    # DATA.C:244-251). Counter = RANDOM(8), lookup G0025[counter]; if the
    # result == C13_SLOT_BACKPACK_LINE1_1 then += RANDOM(17) to select a
    # random backpack slot. Counter loops with += 1 &= 0x0007. Source-
    # locked against DATA.C:244-251 + GROUP.C:1039-1077 + DEFS.H:786/790-
    # 793. Disjoint from pass784-790 + pass791 ammunition-compat

        # do not exist on disk and break the cmake configure step.

function(firestaff_add_dm1_v1_viewport_contract_test target test_src impl_src ctest_name)
    if(BUILD_TESTING AND NOT TARGET ${target})
        add_executable(${target}
            ${test_src}
            ${impl_src}
            ${ARGN}
        )
        target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE firestaff_m10)
        target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
        )
        target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE FIRESTAFF_SOURCE_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
        if(NOT MSVC)
            target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -O2)
        endif()
        add_test(
            NAME ${ctest_name}
            COMMAND ${target}
        )
    endif()
endfunction()

    # Headless regression guard for the FTL swoosh intro animation. Loads
    # SWOOSH from FIRESTAFF_SWOOSH or a canonical path passed via
    # --swsh-swoosh; exercises the same SWSH_Compat_* functions as the
    # runtime; verifies the 4 load-bearing palette mutations
    # (color 1 white, color 10 light grey, color 13 dark grey, color 15
    # yellow final); prints a per-build SHA-256 over the per-step
    # (palette || rgba) digests so regressions can be diff'd across
    # OSes/renderer backends without re-running on real hardware.

# -- Apple Silicon DM V2.0 filtered renderer Metal-path probe --------
# Exercises the V20 indexed filter presentation path end to end:
#   V1 indexed framebuffer -> palette LUT + CRT scanlines ->

    # ── FM Towns BIN/CUE and ISO/CUE redump-layout classifier ─────
    # Bounded data-free classifier that parses redump-style CUE
    # sheets for the FM Towns releases of DM1 (v2.0, 1989-11,
    # tracks 02..20), CSB (v3.1, 1990-12-14, tracks 02..31), and
    # DM2 (v1.0, 1994-01-28, tracks 02..06 + silent track 8).
    # Source of truth: docs/DMWEB_REFERENCE.md lines 37, 44, 51.
    # Deliberately does NOT extract ISO 9660 files, decode IMG2,
    # or launch any FM Towns emulator -- those gates are tracked
    # separately under docs/FIRESTAFF_GAP_LIST.md. The classifier
    # only verifies the disc image layout (track count, audio
    # track count, MODE1/2352 vs MODE1/2048 vs AUDIO) and an
    # optional ISO 9660 Primary Volume Descriptor signature.

    # Verifies the existing m11_gfx_lzw_decompress() in
    # src/dm1/dm1_v1_graphics_loader_pc34_compat.c by:
    #   * providing a test-side reference LZW encoder that
    #     produces bitstreams compatible with the decoder
    #   * round-tripping known patterns (single byte, literal
    #     runs, repeated bytes that exercise KwKwK, image-like
    #     gradients, CLEAR_CODE handling, END_CODE handling,
    #     code-width growth 9 -> 12 bits)
    #
    # Two real bugs were uncovered and fixed by writing this
    # test (see commit message):
    #   1. lzw_reset_dict was clearing the chunk state in
    #      addition to the dictionary, causing every CLEAR_CODE
    #      to be followed by a stale-chunk read.
    #   2. The KwKwK output branch emitted first_char BEFORE the
    #      decoded string instead of after it, producing "AAB"
    #      instead of "ABA" on alternating inputs.
    add_executable(test_dm1_lzw_round_trip
        tests/test_dm1_lzw_round_trip.c
        src/dm1/dm1_v1_graphics_loader_pc34_compat.c
    )

        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include

    endif()
    add_test(
        NAME dm1_lzw_round_trip
        COMMAND test_dm1_lzw_round_trip
    )

# Nexus V1 light-overflow data-model + bug-classification probe.
# Headless and data-free: implements the BUG0_18 timeline-full +
# F0257 recursive-weaker event chain that DMWeb documents as the
# root cause of the light-overflow gameplay bug (permanent Light
# or dungeon-into-darkness symptom on the Saturn DM Nexus port).
# Source-lock: ReDMCSB WIP20210206 Toolchains/Common/Source/
#   DATA.C:359 — LightPowerToLightAmount[16] table
#   MENU.C:1125-1143 — F0404_MENUS_CreateEvent70_Light wrapper
#   MENU.C:1926-1942 — Light / Torch / Darkness spell dispatch
#   TIMELINE.C:487-555 — F0238_AddEvent (BUG0_18 silent drop)
#   TIMELINE.C:1720-1767 — F0257_ProcessEvent70_Light
#   LOADSAVE.C:2041 — EventMaximumCount = 100 base cap
#   CHAMPION.C:27 — MagicalLightAmount field
# Probe verifies: documented table identity, spell-power formulas,
# single-spell decay chain, cast-tick convergence, BUG0_18 silent
# drops, permanent-light classification, light-bleed-through-zero
# classification, guard-mode cast rejection, determinism, NULL safety.
add_executable(firestaff_nexus_v1_light_overflow_probe

# Nexus V1 light-overflow runtime wire-in probe. Headless and data-free:
# implements the M11 wire-in layer declared in
# include/nexus_v1_light_runtime.h. Drives the upstream BUG0_18
# timeline-full + F0257 recursive-weaker event chain through one
# bounded `Nexus_V1_LightRuntime` object, then round-trips its state
# through an FNXS save + reload, and verifies that the classification
# kind (NONE / TIMELINE_FULL_PERMANENT_LIGHT / LIGHT_BLEED_NEGATIVE /
# CAST_REJECTED) survives the wire. Preserve-emulate-vs-guard mode
# distinction is verified by rejecting mode-mismatched saves.
# Source-lock:
#   include/nexus_v1_light_runtime.h   (M11 wire-in API)
#   src/nexus/nexus_v1_light_runtime.c (implementation)
#   include/nexus_v1_light_overflow.h  (data model + classification)
#   src/nexus/nexus_v1_light_overflow.c (BUG0_18 silent drop + F0257)
#   include/nexus_v1_save.h            (FNXS save container)
#   src/nexus/nexus_v1_save_load.c     (FNXS v2 round-trip)
#   ReDMCSB TIMELINE.C F0238 line 487   (BUG0_18 silent drop)
#   ReDMCSB TIMELINE.C F0257 line 1720  (recursive weaker chain)
#   ReDMCSB MENU.C    :1926-1942        (Light/Torch/Darkness dispatch)
#   ReDMCSB LOADSAVE.C:2041             (EventMaximumCount = 100)
#   ReDMCSB CHAMPION.C:27               (MagicalLightAmount field)
# Probe verifies: init/shutdown idempotency, emulate-mode cast,
# guard-mode rejection at cap, BUG0_18 silent drops + permanent-light
# classification, light-bleed-through-zero, save/load round-trip
# (active_count + cast/decay/dropped counters + MagicalLightAmount +
# state-hash), emulate-vs-guard mode flag preservation, FNXS embedding,
# NULL safety, determinism.
add_executable(firestaff_nexus_v1_light_runtime_probe
    probes/nexus/firestaff_nexus_v1_light_runtime_probe.c
)
target_link_libraries(firestaff_nexus_v1_light_runtime_probe PRIVATE
    firestaff_nexus firestaff_m10
)
target_include_directories(firestaff_nexus_v1_light_runtime_probe PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
)
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(firestaff_nexus_v1_light_runtime_probe PRIVATE
        -Wall -Wextra -O2
    )
endif()

# Nexus V1 light-overflow cast-path wire-in + FNXL save/load proof.
# Headless and data-free (no Saturn disc image, FONT256.S2D, MNS
# model, or DGN file). Wires the bounded data-model + bug-
# classification API into a small engine-side bundle (the
# Nexus_V1_LightCastPath) the M11 cast dispatch / a debug overlay /
# a replay capture can drive for every Light / Torch / Darkness
# cast. Preserves the emulate-vs-guard mode distinction via the
# NEXUS_LIGHT_CAST_MODE_EMULATE / NEXUS_LIGHT_CAST_MODE_GUARD
# enum and exposes a per-cast Nexus_V1_LightCastResult so the
# caller can react (HUD warning, cast rejection, replay flag).
# Source-lock: ReDMCSB WIP20210206 Toolchains/Common/Source/
#   MENU.C:1926-1942 — Light / Torch / Darkness dispatch
#   TIMELINE.C:487-555 — F0238_AddEvent (BUG0_18 silent drop)
#   TIMELINE.C:1720-1767 — F0257_ProcessEvent70_Light
#   LOADSAVE.C:2041 — EventMaximumCount = 100 base cap
#   CHAMPION.C:27 — MagicalLightAmount field
# The FNXL save/load proof is a small dedicated binary format
# for the cast-path state (magic 'FNXL', CRC-32 integrity, 36-byte
# fixed header + per-active-slot payload). Distinct from the
# world-save FNXS format in src/nexus/nexus_v1_save_load.c so the
# world format version stays untouched.
# Probe verifies: cast-path init/reset, single Light cast
# classification, cast+tick convergence, BUG0_18 silent drop in
# emulate mode, cast rejection in guard mode, runtime mode flip,
# FNXL round-trip (every state field + every in-use slot
# preserved bit-exact), corruption + truncation rejection,
# 5-run determinism, NULL safety on every entry point, and the
# skip-real-assets contract (the probe links and runs without any
# Saturn asset on disk).
add_executable(firestaff_nexus_v1_light_cast_path_probe
    probes/nexus/firestaff_nexus_v1_light_cast_path_probe.c
)
target_link_libraries(firestaff_nexus_v1_light_cast_path_probe PRIVATE
    firestaff_nexus firestaff_m10
)
target_include_directories(firestaff_nexus_v1_light_cast_path_probe PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
)
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(firestaff_nexus_v1_light_cast_path_probe PRIVATE
        -Wall -Wextra -O2
    )
endif()

# Nexus V1 NGLT (Nexus_V1_LightRuntime) recognition probe.

# src/nexus/nexus_v1_save_load.c:
#   - nexus_v1_save_data_section_has_nglt() predicate

#   - nexus_v1_load_full_from_path_with_runtime() (reader + runtime handoff)

#   include/nexus_v1_light_runtime.h    (NGLT blob layout, magic 'NGLT')
#   include/nexus_v1_light_overflow.h   (cast/decay/drop model)

    # ── Theron V1 Track 02 Level Handoff Probe ────────────────────

    # ── Theron V1 Track 02 Descriptor Entry Role Binding Probe ───
    # Bounded byte-level semantic role binding for each entry of the
    # documented 9-word Track 02 descriptor table.  Pins
    # RESERVED_ZERO_FILL / CONTAINS_DESCRIPTOR_TABLE /
    # PRE_DESCRIPTOR_DATA / POST_DESCRIPTOR_DATA roles derived from
    # the existing window classification plus three descriptor-window
    # markers (byte_before_descriptor_is_rts, all_zero_after_descriptor,
    # first_nonzero_after_descriptor).  Does NOT claim dungeon records,
    # map grids, object tables, palette/text payloads, or runtime
    # loader handoff.  See
    # docs/source-lock/theron_v1_track02_descriptor_entry_roles_H2341.md
    # for the bounded semantic-role claim.
    add_executable(firestaff_theron_v1_track02_descriptor_entry_roles_probe
        probes/theron/firestaff_theron_v1_track02_descriptor_entry_roles_probe.c
    )
    target_link_libraries(firestaff_theron_v1_track02_descriptor_entry_roles_probe PRIVATE
        firestaff_theron
    )
    target_include_directories(firestaff_theron_v1_track02_descriptor_entry_roles_probe PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    )
    if(TARGET firestaff_m12)
        target_link_libraries(firestaff_theron_v1_track02_descriptor_entry_roles_probe PRIVATE firestaff_m12)
    endif()
    if(NOT MSVC)
        target_compile_options(firestaff_theron_v1_track02_descriptor_entry_roles_probe PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -O2)
    endif()
    add_test(
        NAME theron_v1_track02_descriptor_entry_roles
        COMMAND firestaff_theron_v1_track02_descriptor_entry_roles_probe
    )
